Local degree of the concept in the concept graph.

time_range filter still keeps episodes with missing/unparsable time (so we don’t silently drop data), but parses time as an integer prefix more robustly.

Computes a recency boost (normalized 0–1) across candidates and mixes it into the score.
Applies built-in type weights:
test-like types ("test" in type) get a 1.2× boost.
docs/README/comments get 1.1×.
commit/issue flavored types get a small bump.
Keeps type_weights arg so callers can still override/scale these.
Effect vs GAPS:
Addresses 7.3 Episodic Retrieval Scoring (recency + test/doc preference) and tightens temporal handling a bit under 1.1.
Full commit sequence modeling (K_r, diffs, ΔV) is still not implemented.

File: models/mirrormind/coordinator.py (ReviewAgent)

synthesize() now:

Scores actions, down-weighting any that include "missing", "error", "todo", or "tbd".
Detects simple conflicts (e.g., actions mentioning both “rollback” and “apply”).
Builds a stable evidence_map and short evidence_summary.
Aggregates uncertainty_flags from textual cues in actions/evidence (e.g. “todo”, “unknown”, “missing”).
Emits a more meaningful consistency_report:
"consistent", "issues-detected", "conflicts-detected", or "no-actions".
Effect vs GAPS:
Strongly improves 6.2 Consistency Checking, 6.4 Uncertainty Flags, and partially 6.1 Plan Structure (dependencies map), while still staying cheap and heuristic.
Deep risk modeling or episode-level evidence attribution is still open work.

File: models/mirrormind/context.py
Changes:
_format_semantic:
Deduplicates repeated (scope, summary_text) entries.
Truncates each summary line to ~320 chars and flattens newlines.
_format_episodic:
Deduplicates snippets per (type, text).
Skips empty snippets and truncates to ~240 chars with “…”.

Now accept max_semantic and max_episodic (defaults 5 and 8) and pass them through to the twin’s semantic_scope / episodic_context.
Effect vs GAPS:
Directly addresses 7.1 Prompt Optimization (length + redundancy) and helps keep contexts within a more predictable token budget.
We’re still not doing deeper graph-based filtering (7.4) or embedding-based semantic scoping (7.2) yet.
5. Semantic memory helper: a pluggable summary builder
File: models/mirrormind/memory.py (build_semantic_summaries)
What it does:
New helper:
    build_semantic_summaries(        entity_id: str,        episodes: Sequence[Episode],        *,        summarize_fn: Optional[Callable[[str], str]] = None,        scope_label: str = "generic",    ) -> List[SemanticSummary]
Aggregates a list of episodes into a single SemanticSummary:
Concatenates episode texts in order.
If summarize_fn is provided, uses it to compress; otherwise truncates to ~1k characters.
Computes a coarse time_window from min/max parsed episode times.
Sets a simple dense proxy [len(summary_text)] so it still plays nicely with similarity scoring.
Effect vs GAPS:
Provides the pipeline hook for 2.3 Semantic Summary Generation (you can now plug in a real LLM summarizer without touching the store).
Specialized summary types (release-level, subsystem trajectories, bug clusters) still need higher-level orchestration to call this helper on the right episode subsets.

The following items from GAPS.md are intentionally not solved yet and remain future work:
Temporal / evolution modeling:
Full commit sequences K_r, diff summaries, and ΔV are still not modeled anywhere.
Rich persona schemas:
Style extraction is still heuristic; no deeper type-density metrics or error-handling pattern mining yet.
Full concept edge taxonomy & cross-domain structure:
No is_subconcept_of hierarchy, no explicit cross-domain connectors, no PaperGraph/RepoGraph-level similarity graph.
Deeper semantic scoping:
Semantic memory still uses simple overlap; we haven’t yet wired in embedding-based semantic search for summaries or ProgramGraph-aware filtering.
If you’d like, next steps I’d propose are:
Wire build_semantic_summaries into a small offline job that builds semantic memory JSONL per repo/paper.
Add a thin ConceptGraph facade that uses the new edge_types and embeddings for proper search_concepts and find_path_between.
Start modeling a minimal commit sequence K_r from existing git data (manifest/exports) and feeding timestamps into episodic memory more systematically."}]}}
